purpose: Run one separately frozen setup recovery after the R1 Quant-H0 pre-screen ended in model_empty_response. R2 repeats the same public task and execution treatment under a new run identity; it is not an experimental repeat and launches no Evolver, Reviewer, candidate Worker, task repeat, or protection task.

recovery_from.interpretation: The official empty-output score is not a Quant-H0 capability observation and cannot be used for the public rounding audit, proposal selection, or any benchmark claim.

scope.result_role: adaptive development target setup recovery only

selection_evidence.retained_observation: A prior valid Quant-H0 observation scored 36/37 and serialized forward_cross_rates_3M values beyond four decimal places while the public instruction says cross rates are rounded to four decimal places.
selection_evidence.r1_effect: R1 adds no valid task observation and does not replace the retained selection evidence.

limit_enforcement.worker_and_verifier_count: fixed by the single-arm single-task runner invocation
limit_enforcement.requests_tokens_and_provider_cost: post-run audit thresholds; the existing Worker call is not interrupted mid-turn by these accounting thresholds
limit_enforcement.threshold_breach: retain the completed accounting and stop with no follow-on dispatch

post_run_public_audit.input: the unique completed Quant-H0 output/results.json produced by this run
post_run_public_audit.rule: rounding_mismatch_present when at least one numeric bid, ask, or mid value under forward_cross_rates_3M differs from the same value rounded to four decimal places
post_run_public_audit.answer_access: public instruction and Worker artifact only; do not read or construct an optimize-only expected-value diagnostic
post_run_public_audit.effect: This audit may select a later proposal experiment but does not change this official pre-screen result.

terminal_decisions.when: the Worker or official verifier is incomplete, invalid, or missing its required report or artifact
official score is below 37/37 and rounding_mismatch_present is true
official score is below 37/37 and rounding_mismatch_present is false

second_invalid_stop.when: R2 again ends in model_empty_response or any other incomplete or invalid Worker/verifier outcome

answer_boundary: The R2 Quant-H0 Worker receives only the public task, public task data, and the unchanged Quant-H0 harness. R1 execution evidence and retained selection evidence are not Worker-visible. This plan generates no Evolver diagnostic, exposes no official answer or expected value, and launches no reusable candidate.
claim_boundary: R2 is one setup recovery after an invalid empty-response run, not a repeat. A valid completion measures one fresh Quant-H0 official observation and whether its own public artifact still exhibits the predeclared rounding mismatch. An invalid completion is retained only as a second setup failure and ends this recovery path without automatic R3.
